title: OpenClaw gets a Pollinations Connect flow
summary:
OpenClaw setup got simpler, API errors got more useful, and image generation received some route maintenance.

The community-maintained OpenClaw setup page now guides users through Pollinations authorization and fills the returned API key into setup examples. Its provider configuration adds Kimi K2.6 and a DeepSeek fallback, while Kimi K2.5 remains the default.

Using a text, image, or audio model on the wrong endpoint now returns a 400 that points to the right one, rather than an upstream 502. Malformed audio URLs also return a 400 with encoding guidance, and silent Scribe v2 clips can return an empty transcription instead of a 500.

Klein 4B was pointed at a replacement host after an outage. The gpt-image-2 route was first configured across Azure regions, then changed to a direct OpenAI endpoint for generation and edits; the older gptimage routes remain on Azure.

daily.title: Connect Pollinations to OpenClaw
daily.text: Set up Pollinations as an OpenClaw provider through a Connect flow that fills your returned API key into the setup instructions. The provider configuration now includes Kimi K2.6 and a DeepSeek fallback.
